resources.string: This app declares no network permission, so Android itself blocks it from opening a connection. ZIyOffice cannot send your documents anywhere.
No ads, no subscriptions, no accounts, no tracking. Every feature is free, forever.

Your documents stay in the folders you choose on this device. ZIyOffice keeps only a local list of recent files and local recovery copies of unsaved edits; neither is uploaded by this app. Files in a folder that another app syncs may still be synced by that app.
